headings.usage: H1, H2, H3. Use tracking-tight, leading-none for H1, H2.

body.usage: Paragraphs, lists, standard text. Use tracking-normal, leading-relaxed.

labels.usage: Overlines, tech stack tags, numbered chapter markers (e.g., [ 01 ]). Use tracking-[0.2em], uppercase, text-xs.

visual_enhancers.borders: Soft, 1px solid border-zinc-200. Use sparingly to separate grid items or create 'clipped frame' photography looks.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Very subtle ambient shadows for cards/modals: shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(0,0,0,0.04)]
visual_enhancers.corners: Soft corners, not overly rounded. Use rounded-md (6px) or rounded-lg (8px). NO pill-shaped overly rounded AI cards.
visual_enhancers.photography_treatment: Deliberate and editorial. Use 'clipped frames' (images inside div containers with padding, e.g., p-2 bg-white border border-zinc-200). Use grayscale filter on hover or subtle zoom.
visual_enhancers.negative_space: Generous spacing. Use py-24, py-32 for sections. Large gaps in grids (gap-12, gap-16).

layouts.hero: Large kinetic hero. Text left-aligned with masked line-by-line reveal. Portrait on the right, treated with a clipped frame or overlapping an architectural background element.
layouts.manifesto_chapters: Numbered sections (01. ABOUT, 02. SKILLS). Section headers should feature the number in JetBrains Mono and title in Playfair Display.
layouts.skills_grid: Bento-style or editorial column grid (1-col mobile, 2-col or 4-col desktop). No percentage bars. Use clean typography lists with JetBrains Mono tags.
layouts.experience_timeline: Vertical timeline. Clean line running down the left with subtle dot markers. Editorial spacing.
layouts.marquee: One slow, smooth editorial marquee strip (react-fast-marquee) displaying technologies or brand pillars (e.g., 'SYSTEMS / CLOUD / OPERATIONS / SUPPORT').

motion.hero_reveal: Framer Motion line-by-line text reveal using overflow-hidden wrappers on text lines.
motion.parallax: Subtle framer-motion useScroll/useTransform on hero image or background shapes.
motion.scroll_reveal: Framer motion whileInView for section content fading in and drifting up gently (y: 20, opacity: 0 -> y: 0, opacity: 1).
motion.micro_interactions: Subtle scale up (scale-105) on project image hover. Arrow icons shifting right (translate-x-1) on button hover.

hero_portrait.description: Professional confident man with glasses, dark shirt, smartwatch. Use for Hero section.

about_secondary_photo.description: Man in black long sleeve sitting in front of macbook. Use for About Me section.

project_1_image.description: Modern rack-mounted server units. Use for Featured Project 1.

project_2_image.description: Cable network infrastructure. Use for Featured Project 2.

libraries.framer_motion: For animations (line reveal, parallax, scroll reveal).
libraries.lenis: For smooth scrolling. Wrap app in ReactLenis.
libraries.radix_ui: For accessible modals (Project details) and navigation structure if needed.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure dark charcoal text on off-white bg meets AAA standards. Use teal-700/800 for buttons ensuring good contrast with white text.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements (buttons, links, form fields, modals) MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='hero-resume-btn').

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and clipped frames.
Use glass-morphism effects carefully (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70) for sticky navs.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, custom selection states (e.g. teal bg, white text), and loading animations separate good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. NEVER use placeholder text/images.
All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the layout in raw HTML/Tailwind for section structures, using Shadcn for the project detail Modals if needed.
Use Framer Motion to build the 'line-by-line masked reveal' for the H1 in the hero section. Split the text into lines, wrap each in an overflow-hidden div, and animate the inner text sliding up.
Implement a smooth scrolling wrapper using @studio-freight/react-lenis.
Ensure typography matches the Editorial IT Support concept: Playfair Display for big headings, Manrope for body, JetBrains Mono for small uppercase tags.
Do NOT use bright neon colors, progress bars, or spinning elements. Stick to off-white, charcoal, and teal.
Construct the Skills section as a clean typographic grid with 4 categories, not percentage bars.
Create a slow 'react-fast-marquee' strip containing words like 'CLOUD INFRASTRUCTURE • SYSTEMS ADMINISTRATION • NETWORKING • IT SUPPORT'. Use JetBrains Mono or Playfair Display for this strip.
